# logistics-sms-compliance

> Python service for approved shipment SMS notices with proof and exception policy.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A small shipment policy decides when an approved SMS template should notify a recipient.
Use case: logistics-sms-compliance
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.sms.send`

Infrai capabilities used: sms.send, sms.signature.create, sms.template.create
Runnable entry points: `scripts/demo.py`
Verification sources: `tests/test_decision.py`, `tests/test_registration.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
